The paper's text gives no exclusion criteria. Participants marked as excluded here are those with 'experiment finished' = 0 in the subject info, plus one Experiment 1 participant whose 'first attempt' = 0; this reproduces the paper's group sizes (16 and 16 in Experiments 1, 2 and 4; 16 in Experiment 3) and every statistic checked.
